notes.title: Fugue of Delights – Coming July 23rd
notes.content:
Mark the date. Fugue of Delights, the fifth chronicle in the Enygmage universe, will be released on July 23rd. A deeper descent into the textures of desire, delirium, and dream.


Elylah returns — wounded, radiant, and relentless. Vulpes burns. The daemonic dream fractures. And you are not ready.

This new installment brings:

Refined artwork in chiaroscuro dreamscapes.

Tense erotic encounters and layered choices.

A descent into the heart of art, lust, and memory.

The fugue is a spiral. You won’t know what you’ve lost until it ends.


Add to your wishlist now and be the first to descend.  The stage is set. The curtain trembles.

notes.title: Castle of Delights – Artbook + OST – 50% Off
notes.content:
The very essence of the Castle — its lines, its sounds, its secrets — is now yours.
The Artbook and Original Soundtrack for Castle of Delights are 50% off until June 2.

The Artbook unveils what was never fully revealed: sketches, unfinished lines, sacred silhouettes, and the ritualistic process behind every chamber, every shadow, every forbidden door.

The Original Soundtrack carries the echo of the Castle — footsteps on marble, whispers behind locked doors, the pulse of seduction beneath high vaulted ceilings.
It’s a soundscape of longing, power, and surrender.

But even within these walls... a tremor begins.
A new fugue is forming.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827849/1f0bd4470416392b84d3acbe833c8d055ffc7c3d.png
It’s only a glimpse.
A fragment.
A sketch left behind in the making of something yet unnamed.

The Castle stands.
But the Dream shifts once more.

notes.title: Castle of Delights – 50% Off
notes.content:
Castle of Delights is now 50% off until June 2.

Behind its gates, desire becomes ritual. Every corridor hides a trial, every chamber holds a secret.
It’s a castle built from the longings of those who dared to dream — and were never the same after crossing its threshold.

This is not merely a place. It’s a reflection of the Dream itself — seduction, temptation, surrender, and power, all woven into a labyrinth of shadows and ecstasy.

And yet... as the echoes of this castle continue to reverberate...
A new fugue begins to stir.

The veil shifts.
Something new is coming.

notes.title: Castle DLCs — Sound and Skin Preserved in Stillness (50% off)
notes.content:
Some echoes can’t be heard again.
Some images can’t be unseen.
But this week, both can be kept — at half their price.

 The Castle of Delights Original Soundtrack is composed in full by the creator of the series. It’s a low-fi sonic ritual built from synthesized textures, ambient tones and emotional cadences — designed for oneiric immersion and private listening. These aren’t loops. They are memories.

 The Official Artbook brings you a silent gallery from the castle’s hidden halls.
Dozens of illustrations, character studies and alternate moments — including pieces that whisper of stories yet untold.

You’ll hear Vulpes fall silent behind a curtain.
You’ll see Zamora when she’s not speaking.
You’ll remember Elylah... before she knew what would come next.

 And you won’t be alone.

Nearly 900 dreamers still have this Castle on their wishlist.
Not all of them will enter.
But this week, you can.

A fugue is forming beyond these walls.
You may already feel it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827849/c588e62b68291d578c21f63368eb6984607a92f0.png

notes.title: Castle of Delights — Mirrors, Daemons and Desires (50% off)
notes.content:
Some places don’t trap you with walls.
They trap you with memories.

Castle of Delights is the second step in Elylah’s journey — a chapter of reverberations and emotional collision. The castle is not only a setting, but a mirror. And inside it, Elylah, Vulpes, and the Dreamer Zamora must each confront what they see… and what they hide.

 The castle contains:


 Forbidden baths and a monster of jelly

 Chambers filled with forgotten paintings — some prophetic

 The soft tension of women who want, but don't ask

 And the moment Nostalgia appears, without warning


 This is the game where the world begins to shape itself.
Where the lore deepens. Where Elylah's voice grows.
And where your choices paint what cannot be unseen.

 This week, the Castle opens its doors at 50% off.

Nearly 900 dreamers still wish to enter this castle.
Their desire remains... unanswered.
Will you be the one to open the door?

And just beyond these painted halls, something darker is tuning its strings.
A fugue is forming — and Elylah will not descend alone.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827849/794925c377bdcf350910907d99f8d250ca14d29d.png

 Also... For those who crave the art in stillness, a new illustrated codex is nearing completion.

Take your time in the castle.
It will remember you.
